result.rationale: Two nights of sleep-onset difficulty after a shift change is plausibly circadian adjustment, but the patient reports significant daytime impairment (unable to concentrate, unable to complete ordinary tasks, feeling unable to cope). Reported daytime impact supports clinician contact to assess mood/distress, shift-work adjustment, and coping; no emergency features (no substance use, no mania-like energy, no reported safety concerns), so messaging-based assessment is appropriate.
